training_samples.response_template_english:
⚠️ **Buyer Login Troubleshooting – What It Means**

If login fails, here is what each error usually means:

**❌ "Invalid email or password"**
→ The system did **not** match your credentials.
• Check if **Caps Lock** is off
• Double-check your email spelling
• If you forgot your password, use **"Forgot Password"** on the login page: https://bahai-frontend.onrender.com/login.html

**❌ "Email not verified"**
→ Your account exists, but your email is **not yet verified**.
• Check your inbox for the **6-digit verification code**
• If you can’t find it, use **"Resend Code"**

**❌ "Account not found"**
→ There is **no buyer account** registered with that email.
• Make sure you signed up as a **buyer**
• You may need to **create a new account**: https://bahai-frontend.onrender.com/signup.html

**❌ "Too many attempts"**
→ For security, your login is **temporarily locked**.
• Wait **15 minutes** before trying again
• Consider resetting your password

💡 The system is designed to **protect your account** from unauthorized access.

training_samples.response_template_english:
🪪 **Buyer KYC – What It Is & How It Works**

**What is KYC?**
KYC (Know Your Customer) is identity verification. It confirms you are a real person using a valid ID and a face match check.

**Why is KYC needed?**
• **Safer accounts** – Reduces fake or spam accounts
• **Protects you & sellers** – Brokers/landlords know they’re talking to verified buyers
• **More secure platform** – Helps keep BahAI trustworthy for everyone

**What do you need to do?**
1️⃣ Upload a **valid Government ID** (National ID, Driver’s License, Passport, UMID, etc.)
2️⃣ Take a **selfie with your ID** (hold ID next to your face)
3️⃣ The system runs a **face match** – your selfie is compared to your ID photo
4️⃣ You must pass a **70% match score** to be verified

**How it works:**
Your ID and selfie are checked using **Face++** technology. The system compares your face in the selfie with the photo on your ID. If the match is 70% or higher, your account is verified. Your data is encrypted and secure.

**What you can access when KYC verified:**
✅ Message brokers and landlords directly
✅ Schedule property viewings

training_samples.response_template_tagalog:
🪪 **Buyer KYC – Ano Ito at Paano Gumagana**

**Ano ang KYC?**
Ang KYC (Know Your Customer) ay identity verification. Pinapatunayan nito na tunay kang tao gamit ang valid ID at face match check.

**Bakit kailangan ang KYC?**
• **Mas ligtas na accounts** – Mas kaunti ang fake o spam accounts
• **Proteksyon para sa iyo at sellers** – Alam ng brokers/landlords na verified buyer ang kausap nila
• **Mas secure na platform** – Tumutulong panatilihing mapagkakatiwalaan ang BahAI para sa lahat

**Ano ang kailangan mong gawin?**
1️⃣ Mag-upload ng **valid Government ID** (National ID, Driver’s License, Passport, UMID, etc.)
2️⃣ Kumuha ng **selfie with ID** (hawak ang ID sa tabi ng mukha)
3️⃣ Magra-run ang system ng **face match** – ikinumpara ang selfie mo sa photo sa ID
4️⃣ Dapat **70% o higit** ang match score para ma-verify

**Paano gumagana:**
Tine-check ang ID at selfie mo gamit ang **Face++** technology. Ikumpara ng system ang mukha mo sa selfie sa photo sa ID. Kung 70% o mas mataas ang match, verified na ang account mo. Encrypted at secure ang iyong data.

**Ano ang pwede mong gawin kapag KYC verified:**
✅ Mag-message sa brokers at landlords
✅ Mag-schedule ng property viewings
✅ Mag-submit ng formal offers sa properties
✅ Mag-build ng trust sa sellers

**Mag-complete ng KYC dito:** https://bahai-frontend.onrender.com/buyer/buyer-kyc.html

**Access kapag walang KYC:**
• **Guest:** View only – walang save, message, o schedule
• **Naka-login (walang KYC):** Pwede mag-save/like ng properties, pero hindi pwede mag-message o mag-schedule ng viewing

**After you log in & what you see on the dashboard**

When you **successfully log in** to the system, you are **redirected to the Buyer Dashboard** (your home page). There you can see:

• **Search bar and filters** – location, property type, price, etc.
• **Category cards** – e.g. Houses, Condos, Apartments
• **AI Recommendations** section – personalized when you're logged in (see "How do recommendations work?")
• **Grid of listings** – from any card you can open full details or tap the heart to **save** (if logged in)

**1. Buyer Dashboard** – As above. Your home page after login.

**2. Saved / Liked Properties** – In the sidebar, open **Saved Properties**. There you see **all properties you've saved**. You can open each for full details, remove from saved, or compare. You save from the dashboard or search results by clicking the heart on a listing; you must be **logged in** to save. Guests can only browse.

**3. Messages** – To **send or read messages** you must be **logged in** and **KYC approved**. Once you are, open **Messages** from the sidebar. You see a **list of conversations** (each with a broker or landlord; some are about a specific property). You can search and filter (all / unread / today). Tap a conversation to open the **chat thread** and send messages. You can also **start a conversation from a property**: on the property’s full details page, use **Message** or **Contact** to chat with that listing’s owner or broker about that property. Messaging is only for KYC-verified buyers so brokers know they’re talking to verified users.

**4. Schedule Viewing** – When you’re logged in (and KYC where required), you can **request a viewing** for a property. From the property details or the Schedule Viewing page you choose **date and time** and submit; the broker or owner receives the request and can confirm.

**5. Search Results** – When you use the **search bar or filters** on the dashboard, results appear (e.g. on the Search Results page). You see the same listing cards: you can **refine filters**, open **full property details** (description, price, location, map, amenities, photos), **save** (if logged in), or **message** (if KYC approved) from there.

**6. KYC** – Identity verification (ID + selfie) is required to **use Messages**. Until then you can still browse, search, save, and get recommendations. Link: buyer-kyc.html.

**Quick rules:** Guest = browse and search only. Logged in = save, personalized recommendations, request viewings. Logged in + KYC = full messaging with brokers and landlords.

training_samples.response_template_english:
**How Recommendations Work**

On the **Buyer Dashboard**, the **"AI Recommendations For You"** section shows properties picked for you.

**How they are fetched (when you're logged in):**
1. **From your saved/liked properties** – The system finds listings similar to what you've saved (same area, property type, price range, or features). The more you save, the better the match.
2. **From your browsing history** – What you've viewed recently is used to suggest more of the same kind.
3. **From your location (if you allow it)** – When location is on (browser or saved in the app), recommendations can use your **map location** to show properties **near you** or in areas you prefer.
4. **From your search behavior** – Types and keywords you search for help rank listings.
5. If there isn't enough data yet, we show **featured** or popular properties.

**Guests:** You only see **featured** or default listings. To get **personalized** recommendations (based on likes, history, and location), **log in**. The dashboard will show: "Sign in to save properties and get personalized AI recommendations."

**Summary:** Logged in = recommendations based on your liked properties, browsing, and (when allowed) your map location. Guest = featured only.
training_samples.response_template_tagalog:
**Paano Gumagana ang Recommendations**

Sa **Buyer Dashboard**, ang **"AI Recommendations For You"** section ay mga property na pinili para sa iyo.

**Paano sila kinukuha (kapag naka-login ka):**
1. **Mula sa saved/liked mo** – Hahanap ang system ng listings na katulad ng na-save mo (same area, type, price range, o features). Mas marami kang save, mas maganda ang match.
2. **Mula sa browsing history mo** – Ang mga napag-view mo ay ginagamit para mag-suggest ng mas katulad.
3. **Mula sa location mo (kung pinayagan mo)** – Kapag naka-on ang location (browser o saved sa app), pwedeng gamitin ang **map location** mo para ipakita ang properties **malapit sa iyo** o sa gusto mong area.
4. **Mula sa search behavior mo** – Mga type at keywords na hinahanap mo ay tumutulong i-rank ang listings.
5. Kung kulang pa ang data, **featured** o popular properties ang ipapakita.

**Guest:** **Featured** o default listings lang. Para sa **personalized** recommendations (batay sa likes, history, at location), **mag-log in**. May prompt: "Sign in to save properties and get personalized AI recommendations."

**Buod:** Naka-login = recommendations batay sa liked properties, browsing, at (kung allowed) map location mo. Guest = featured lang.

Sure, I'm happy to explain how you can reach and message agents or property owners.

**Two easy ways to start a conversation:**

2️⃣ **From their profile** – On that same **Contact Owner** section there's a **View profile** link. Open it to go to their profile page. On the profile you'll also see a **Message** button so you can start or continue the conversation there.

**Why do I need to be verified to message?** We use **KYC (Know Your Customer)** for buyers who want to message. That way agents and landlords know they're talking to a verified person, and the platform stays safer for everyone. You can still browse, search, and save properties without KYC; only **messaging** requires you to be logged in and KYC verified. If you're not verified yet, the app will guide you to complete KYC when you try to message.

So in short: open a property → **Contact Owner** → **Message**, or **View profile** → **Message**. If you hit any step that's unclear, tell me what you see on the screen and I can walk you through it.
